name: Love To Hate You
source:
You lost your job. Forced to move into a shared apartment, you quickly realize you're going to be living with the people who got you fired.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你丟了工作，被迫搬進一間合租公寓，很快才發現，今後要跟你住在一起的，正是害你丟工作的人。

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
